blocks.text: Fe'l + predlog: listen to, look at, wait for

Ko'p fe'llar to'ldiruvchidan oldin **ma'lum bir predlog** talab qiladi: listen **to** music, look **at** the picture, wait **for** the bus. O'zbekchada bu vazifani kelishik qo'shimchasi bajaradi va ko'pincha u **tushum kelishigi** (`-ni`) bo'ladi: musiqa**ni** tinglayman, avtobus**ni** kutyapman — ya'ni hech qanday «predlog» sezilmaydi. Shuning uchun o'zbeklar «listen music», «wait the bus» deb predlogni tushirib qoldiradi. Boshqa tomondan, `-ga` har doim ham **to** emas: rasm**ga** qaramoq — look **at**, ob-havo**ga** bog'liq — depend **on**. Xulosa: fe'lni predlogi bilan **birga** yodlang.

Eng xavfli guruh — o'zbekchada tushum kelishigi (`-ni`) bilan keladigan, inglizchada esa predlog talab qiladigan fe'llar: listen **to** (...ni tinglamoq), wait **for** (...ni kutmoq), look **for** (...ni qidirmoq), ask **for** (...ni so'ramoq). Predlogsiz aytilsa, gap noto'g'ri yoki tushunarsiz bo'ladi. **wait** ga e'tibor bering: wait **for** somebody — kimnidir kutmoq; «wait him» — xato.

items.text: We **waited for** the doctor for an hour.
Could you **ask for** the menu, please?

blocks.text: look at, look for, look after

**look** fe'li predlogga qarab uch xil ma'no beradi: look **at** — ko'z bilan qaramoq (look **at** the sky); look **for** — qidirmoq (look **for** your glasses); look **after** — g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, qarab turmoq (look **after** the children). Qiziq tomoni: o'zbekchada «qaramoq» ham ikki ma'noli — «rasmga qaramoq» (**at**) va «bolaga qaramoq» (**after**).

items.text: Kamola **looks after** her little cousins on Saturdays.
items.translation: Shanba kunlari Kamola kichkina jiyanlari**ga qaraydi**.

blocks.text: talk to, depend on, think about, agree with

**talk / speak to** somebody **about** something — kimdir **bilan** nimadir **haqida** gaplashmoq. **depend on** — «...ga bog'liq»; javobda ko'pincha yolg'iz ishlatiladi: It **depends**. — Vaziyatga qarab. **think about** — o'ylamoq, fikr yuritmoq; **think of** — fikri, bahosi: What do you **think of** this film? — Bu film haqida fikringiz qanday? **agree with** — rozi bo'lmoq, qo'shilmoq; **belong to** — tegishli bo'lmoq; **happen to** — «...ga nima bo'ldi»; **laugh at** — ...ga kulmoq.

items.text: I need to **talk to** you **about** your homework.

blocks.text: Predlogsiz fe'llar: phone, answer, discuss, marry

Teskari tuzoq ham bor: o'zbekchada qo'shimcha yoki ko'makchi bor, inglizchada esa fe'l to'ldiruvchini **to'g'ridan-to'g'ri**, predlogsiz oladi. phone / call somebody (...ga qo'ng'iroq qilmoq), answer a question (savol**ga** javob bermoq), discuss a problem (muammo **haqida** gaplashmoq), enter a room (xona**ga** kirmoq), marry somebody (...ga uylanmoq), meet somebody (... **bilan** uchrashmoq), reach a place (...ga yetib bormoq). **explain** da esa kishi oldidan **to** kerak: explain something **to** me («explain me» emas).

items.text: Kamola **phoned** her brother from the airport.
Can you **explain** the rules **to** the new players?
items.translation: Qoidalarni yangi o'yinchilar**ga tushuntirib bera olasizmi**?

blocks.text: So'roq gapda predlog fe'ldan ajralmaydi va **gap oxirida** qoladi: Who are you waiting **for**? What are you looking **at**? Who does this belong **to**? O'zbekchada esa so'roq so'z qo'shimchani o'zi oladi: Kim**ni** kutyapsiz? Nima**ga** qarayapsiz? Bu qoida 46-darsda (Who is she talking to?) va 102-darsda (the people we talked **to**) ham bor.

items.text: Who did you **speak to**? — The receptionist.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «listen music» → **listen to music**; «wait him» → **wait for him**; «look the picture» → **look at the picture**; «I'm searching my keys» → **looking for my keys**; «depend from» → **depend on**; «phone to him» → **phone him**; «answer to the question» → **answer the question**; «discuss about» → **discuss**; «married with» → **married** (fe'l) / **married to** (sifat — 112-dars); «explain me» → **explain to me**.

Fe'lni predlogi bilan bitta so'zdek yodlang va o'zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing: I **listen to** ... every day; I'm **looking for** ...; I **depend on** .... Teskari ro'yxatni ham eslang: **phone, answer, discuss, enter, marry, meet** — predlogsiz.

Bog'lanish: sifat + predlog (afraid of, good at) — 112-dars; savolda predlog oxirida — 46-dars; aniqlovchi ergash gapda predlog oxirida (the hotel you stayed at) — 102-dars; frazali fe'llar (look up, get on) — 114–115-darslar.

rows: listen to, talk / speak to, belong to, happen to, explain ... to
wait for, look for, ask for, pay for, apply for
enter a room, reach a place
think about / of, dream about, look after

examples.title: **listen to** and **wait for**
examples.description: O'zbekchada `-ni`: musiqa**ni** tinglamoq, avtobus**ni** kutmoq. Inglizchada predlog shart: listen **to** music, wait **for** the bus. «listen music», «wait the bus» — xato.

sentences.text: I **listen to** the radio every morning in the car.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab mashinada radio**ni tinglayman**.

sentences.text: We're **waiting for** the bus — it's ten minutes late.
sentences.translation: Avtobus**ni kutyapmiz** — o'n daqiqa kechikyapti.

sentences.text: **Listen to** me carefully — this is important.
sentences.translation: Meni diqqat bilan **tinglang** — bu muhim.

sentences.text: Who are you **waiting for**? — My sister.
sentences.translation: Kim**ni kutyapsiz**? — Singlimni.

sentences.text: Madina loves **listening to** old Uzbek songs.
sentences.translation: Madina eski o'zbek qo'shiqlari**ni tinglashni** juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Don't **wait for** me — I'll be late tonight.
sentences.translation: Meni **kutmang** — bugun kech qolaman.

sentences.text: Nobody was **listening to** the teacher because the lesson was so boring.
sentences.translation: Dars juda zerikarli bo'lgani uchun hech kim o'qituvchi**ni tinglamayotgan** edi.

sentences.text: How long have you been **waiting for** your visa?
sentences.translation: Vizangiz**ni** qachondan beri **kutyapsiz**?

sentences.text: Bekzod never **listens to** advice — he always does what he wants.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hech qachon maslahat**ga quloq solmaydi** — doim xohlaganini qiladi.

sentences.text: We **waited for** Aziz for half an hour, and then we went in without him.
sentences.translation: Aziz**ni** yarim soat **kutdik**, keyin usiz kirdik.

examples.title: **look at**, **look for**, **look after**
examples.description: Uch xil ma'no: look **at** — ...ga qaramoq; look **for** — ...ni qidirmoq; look **after** — ...ga g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, qarab turmoq.

sentences.text: **Look at** this photo — that's me when I was five!
sentences.translation: Bu surat**ga qarang** — bu besh yoshligimdagi men!

sentences.text: I'm **looking for** my keys. Have you seen them?
sentences.translation: Kalitlarim**ni qidiryapman**. Ko'rmadingizmi?

sentences.text: Who **looks after** the children when you're at work?
sentences.translation: Siz ishdaligingizda bolalar**ga** kim **qaraydi**?

sentences.text: Why are you **looking at** me like that?
sentences.translation: Nega men**ga** bunday **qarayapsiz**?

sentences.text: Emma is **looking for** a new job in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Emma Manchesterdan yangi ish **qidiryapti**.

sentences.text: Can you **look after** my cat while I'm on holiday?
sentences.translation: Men ta'tildaligimda mushugim**ga qarab turasizmi**?

sentences.text: The tourists were **looking at** the beautiful tiles of the Shah-i-Zinda.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar Shohi Zindaning chiroyli koshinlari**ga qarashardi**.

sentences.text: We spent an hour **looking for** a parking space.
sentences.translation: Mashina qo'yishga joy **qidirib** bir soat vaqt sarfladik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **looked after** her grandmother when she was ill.
sentences.translation: Buvisi kasal bo'lganda Dilnoza **unga qaradi**.

sentences.text: I'm not **looking at** your phone — I'm **looking for** mine!
sentences.translation: Men telefoningiz**ga qarayotganim** yo'q — o'zimnikini **qidiryapman**!

examples.title: **ask for**, **pay for**, **apply for**
examples.description: **for** bilan: ask (somebody) **for** something (...dan ...ni so'ramoq), pay **for** (... uchun to'lamoq), apply **for** (...ga ariza topshirmoq), search **for** (...ni qidirmoq).

sentences.text: We're ready to go — let's **ask for** the bill.
sentences.translation: Ketishga tayyormiz — hisob**ni so'raylik**.

sentences.text: Who **paid for** the meal? — Aziz did.
sentences.translation: Ovqat **uchun** kim **to'ladi**? — Aziz.

sentences.text: Madina has **applied for** a job at a big bank.
sentences.translation: Madina katta bankdagi ish**ga ariza topshirdi**.

sentences.text: I **asked** the waiter **for** a glass of water.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant**dan** bir stakan suv **so'radim**.

sentences.text: You don't have to **pay for** the children — they're free.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **uchun to'lashingiz** shart emas — ular bepul.

sentences.text: If you need help, **ask for** Mr Brown at reception.
sentences.translation: Yordam kerak bo'lsa, qabul bo'limida janob Braun**ni so'rang**.

sentences.text: How much did you **pay for** your new phone?
sentences.translation: Yangi telefoningiz **uchun** qancha **to'ladingiz**?

sentences.text: Bekzod **applied for** a visa last month, and he's still waiting.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'tgan oy viza**ga ariza topshirdi** va hali ham kutyapti.

sentences.text: The police are **searching for** the missing boy.
sentences.translation: Politsiya yo'qolgan bola**ni qidiryapti**.

sentences.text: Sarah **asked** her neighbour **for** help when her car wouldn't start.
sentences.translation: Mashinasi o't olmaganda Sara qo'shnisi**dan yordam so'radi**.

examples.title: **talk to**, **belong to**, **happen to**
examples.description: **to** bilan: talk / speak **to** somebody (... bilan gaplashmoq), write **to** (...ga yozmoq), belong **to** (...ga tegishli bo'lmoq), happen **to** (...ga nima bo'ldi), explain something **to** somebody.

sentences.text: Can I **speak to** the manager, please?
sentences.translation: Menejer **bilan gaplashsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Who were you **talking to** on the phone just now? You sounded upset.
sentences.translation: Hozirgina telefonda kim **bilan gaplashayotgan** edingiz? Ovozingiz xafa eshitildi.

sentences.text: This bag doesn't **belong to** me. Whose is it?
sentences.translation: Bu sumka men**ga tegishli** emas. Kimniki u?

sentences.text: What **happened to** your car? It's covered in scratches!
sentences.translation: Mashinangiz**ga nima bo'ldi**? Hammayog'i tirnalgan!

sentences.text: I **write to** my grandparents in Bukhara every month.
sentences.translation: Har oy Buxorodagi bobo-buvim**ga** xat **yozaman**.

sentences.text: Could you **explain** this rule **to** me again?
sentences.translation: Bu qoidani men**ga** yana bir bor **tushuntirib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Have you **talked to** your parents about your plans?
sentences.translation: Rejalaringiz haqida ota-onangiz **bilan gaplashdingizmi**?

sentences.text: These old books **belonged to** my grandfather.
sentences.translation: Bu eski kitoblar bobom**ga tegishli** edi.

sentences.text: Nothing bad will **happen to** you — I promise.
sentences.translation: Senga hech qanday yomon narsa **bo'lmaydi** — va'da beraman.

sentences.text: Tom **spoke to** the hotel staff, and they gave us a better room.
sentences.translation: Tom mehmonxona xodimlari **bilan gaplashdi** va ular bizga yaxshiroq xona berishdi.

examples.title: **depend on**, **think about**, **agree with**
examples.description: depend **on** (...ga bog'liq), think **about** (... haqida o'ylamoq), think **of** (fikr: What do you think of ...?), agree **with** (... bilan rozi bo'lmoq), laugh **at**, dream **about**.

sentences.text: Are you coming tomorrow? — I don't know. It **depends on** the weather.
sentences.translation: Ertaga kelasizmi? — Bilmayman. Ob-havo**ga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: I often **think about** my childhood in the village.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi bolaligim **haqida** tez-tez **o'ylayman**.

sentences.text: What do you **think of** my new haircut?
sentences.translation: Yangi soch turmagim **haqida** qanday **fikrdasiz**?

sentences.text: I completely **agree with** you.
sentences.translation: Siz **bilan** to'liq **roziman**.

sentences.text: Everyone **laughed at** Bekzod's joke.
sentences.translation: Hamma Bekzodning hazili**ga kuldi**.

sentences.text: The price **depends on** the size of the room.
sentences.translation: Narx xonaning kattaligi**ga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: Madina **dreams about** travelling round the world one day.
sentences.translation: Madina bir kun dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish**ni orzu qiladi**.

sentences.text: I don't **agree with** everything he says, but he's a good teacher.
sentences.translation: Uning hamma gapi**ga** ham **qo'shilmayman**, lekin u yaxshi o'qituvchi.

sentences.text: Please don't **laugh at** me — I'm trying my best!
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **ustimdan kulmang** — qo'limdan kelganini qilyapman!

sentences.text: We're **thinking about** going to Khiva in the spring — any advice?
sentences.translation: Bahorda Xivaga borish**ni o'ylayapmiz** — maslahatingiz bormi?

examples.title: No preposition: **phone**, **answer**, **discuss**, **marry**
examples.description: Teskari holat: o'zbekchada qo'shimcha bor, inglizchada predlog yo'q: phone somebody (...ga qo'ng'iroq qilmoq), answer a question, discuss something, enter, marry, meet.

sentences.text: I'll **phone** you tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun siz**ga qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: Please **answer** all the questions on the page.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, sahifadagi barcha savollar**ga javob bering**.

sentences.text: We **discussed** the problem at the meeting.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda muammo**ni muhokama qildik**.

sentences.text: Aziz is going to **marry** a girl from Namangan.
sentences.translation: Aziz namanganlik qiz**ga uylanmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Everyone stood up when the judge **entered** the room.
sentences.translation: Sudya xona**ga kirganda** hamma o'rnidan turdi.

sentences.text: Can you **call** me when you **reach** the hotel?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona**ga yetib borganingizda** men**ga qo'ng'iroq qila olasizmi**?

sentences.text: I **met** an old school friend at the market yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha bozorda maktabdagi eski do'stim **bilan uchrashib qoldim**.

sentences.text: Sarah didn't **answer** my email, so I sent another one.
sentences.translation: Sara xatim**ga javob bermadi**, shuning uchun yana bittasini yubordim.

sentences.text: Let's not **discuss** politics at the dinner table.
sentences.translation: Dasturxon atrofida siyosat**ni muhokama qilmaylik**.

sentences.text: When Dilnoza **married** James, they had two weddings — one in London and one in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Jeyms**ga turmushga chiqqanda** ikkita to'y qilishdi — biri Londonda, biri Toshkentda.

examples.title: Who are you waiting **for**? — Questions
examples.description: Savolda predlog fe'l bilan qoladi — gap oxirida: Who are you talking **to**? What are you looking **at**? (46-dars). Javob — qisqa.

sentences.text: Who are you **waiting for**? — My friend Bekzod.
sentences.translation: Kim**ni kutyapsiz**? — Do'stim Bekzodni.

sentences.text: What are you **looking at**? — That strange bird on the roof.
sentences.translation: Nima**ga qarayapsiz**? — Tomdagi anavi g'alati qushga.

sentences.text: Who does this umbrella **belong to**? — I think it's Emma's.
sentences.translation: Bu soyabon kim**ga tegishli**? — Menimcha, Emmaniki.

sentences.text: Is that music you're **listening to**? — No, it's a podcast about history.
sentences.translation: **Tinglayotganingiz** musiqami? — Yo'q, tarix haqidagi podkast.

sentences.text: Which job did Madina **apply for**? — The one at the airport.
sentences.translation: Madina qaysi ish**ga ariza topshirdi**? — Aeroportdagisiga.

sentences.text: Who were you **talking to** at the party? — Sarah's brother — he's really funny.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda kim **bilan gaplashdingiz**? — Saraning akasi bilan — u juda kulgili.

sentences.text: Does the price **depend on** the season? — Yes, it's higher in summer.
sentences.translation: Narx mavsum**ga bog'liqmi**? — Ha, yozda qimmatroq.

sentences.text: What are you **thinking about**? You look worried.
sentences.translation: Nima **haqida o'ylayapsiz**? Xavotirda ko'rinasiz.

sentences.text: Will anyone **look after** the dog while we're away? — Yes, our neighbour.
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda itga **qarab turadigan** biror kishi bormi? — Ha, qo'shnimiz.

sentences.text: What's everybody **laughing at**? — Tom fell into the swimming pool with his clothes on!
sentences.translation: Hamma nima**ga kulyapti**? — Tom kiyimi bilan basseynga yiqilib tushdi!

examples.title: Dialogue: looking for a lost phone
examples.description: Suhbat: fe'l + predlog bir vaziyatda — look for, look like, belong to, ask for, phone (predlogsiz), depend on, talk to, wait for, think about, worry about.

sentences.text: — Excuse me, I'm **looking for** my phone. I think I left it on the train.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, telefonim**ni qidiryapman**. Menimcha, poyezdda qoldirib ketdim.

sentences.text: — I'll check. What does it **look like**?
sentences.translation: — Tekshirib ko'raman. U qanaqa **ko'rinishda**?

sentences.text: — It's black, with a red case. It **belongs to** my company, so it's very important.
sentences.translation: — Qora, qizil g'ilofli. U kompaniyam**ga tegishli**, shuning uchun juda muhim.

sentences.text: — Wait a moment, please. I'll **ask** my colleague **for** the list of lost things.
sentences.translation: — Bir daqiqa kuting. Hamkasbim**dan** yo'qolgan buyumlar ro'yxati**ni so'rayman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks. I've already **phoned** my number twice, but nobody answered.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Raqamim**ga** ikki marta **qo'ng'iroq qildim**, lekin hech kim javob bermadi.

sentences.text: — Sorry, it isn't on the list yet. It **depends on** when the train comes back.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, u hali ro'yxatda yo'q. Bu poyezd qachon qaytishi**ga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: — Can I **talk to** the driver? Maybe he's seen it.
sentences.translation: — Mashinist **bilan gaplashsam** bo'ladimi? Balki u ko'rgandir.

sentences.text: — He's on his way to Samarkand. But you can **wait for** the train here — it's back at six.
sentences.translation: — U Samarqandga ketyapti. Lekin poyezd**ni** shu yerda **kutishingiz** mumkin — soat oltida qaytadi.

sentences.text: — All right, I'll wait. I can't **think about** anything else now anyway.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, kutaman. Baribir hozir boshqa hech narsa **haqida o'ylay olmayman**.

sentences.text: — Don't **worry about** it. Most phones come back to us, I promise.
sentences.translation: — **Xavotir olmang**. Ko'p telefonlar bizga qaytib keladi, va'da beraman.
